raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ## Motivation GLM-5.3-Flash MTP 5/1/6 decode runs 6 `sm100_paged_mqa_logits_metadata` kernels per step, 2 in each gap between the verify, draft-extend and draft graphs. GLM-5.3 runs 3. The extra 3 build the token-level DeepGEMM schedule, which has no reader when `index_kpool > 1`. Every indexer layer is then `IndexerKPool`, and it reads only the pooled schedule. ## Modifications - `DeepseekSparseAttnBackend` gets `needs_paged_mqa_schedule` (`index_kpool <= 1`), set once in `__init__`. - When the flag is false, the backend no longer builds `paged_mqa_schedule_metadata` or its 2D ctx lens `paged_mqa_ctx_lens_2d`. That covers eager init, CUDA graph capture, graph replay and replay from precomputed metadata. Both fields stay `None`. - The MTP sibling-copy path runs only with KPool metadata fusion, so its copy of these two fields is removed rather than skipped. A backend that needs the schedule now takes the full recompute there instead. - The top-k v2 plan refresh is unchanged and still runs on every path. - `_refresh_paged_mqa_ctx_lens_2d` replaces 3 copies of the same allocate-or-copy block. Only `dsa_indexer.py` (`Indexer`) reads `paged_mqa_schedule_metadata` / `paged_mqa_ctx_lens_2d`. `IndexerKPool._get_topk_paged` takes the schedule from `pooled_paged_mqa_schedule_metadata` or `kpool_write_plan.pool_schedule_metadata`. `deepseek_v2.py` picks `IndexerKPool` for every layer, the MTP layer included, whenever `index_kpool > 1`. Only GLM-5.3-Flash sets `index_kpool` (4); DeepSeek-V3.2 and GLM-5 through 5.3 use 1 and are unchanged. ## Accuracy Tests sgl-eval 0.1.2 GSM8K, 200 examples, temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, thinking on. | Model | GSM8K before | GSM8K after | Accept length (conc. 1) before | Accept length after | |---|---:|---:|---:|---:| | GLM-5.3-Flash | 98.0% | 98.5% | 4.49 | 4.48 | `test_dsa_metadata_replay.py` now also checks that KPool replay leaves `paged_mqa_schedule_metadata` and `paged_mqa_ctx_lens_2d` unset. With `test_dsa_kpool_metadata_fusion.py` and `test_dsa_metadata.py`: 12 passed (7 subtests) on GB300. ## Speed Tests and Profiling GLM-5.3-Flash, 4× GB300, `--tp-size 4`, trtllm DSA, fp8_e4m3 KV, `flashinfer_trtllm` MoE, EAGLE 5/1/6, greedy, 2,048 output tokens. Accept length pinned with `SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_LEN=5 SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_TOKEN_MODE=real-draft-token` (5.00 on every run). | | Before | After | |---|---:|---:| | `fwd_occupancy`, concurrency 1 / 8 / 32 | 93.18 / 94.65 / 93.07% | 93.45 / 94.77 / 93.22% | nsys, batch size 1, medians over ~165–175 steps: | | Before | After | |---|---:|---:| | `sm100_paged_mqa_logits_metadata` per step | 5.93 | 2.88 | | Eager memcpys per step | 50.7 | 43.5 | | Gap: draft-extend → draft | 285 µs | 274 µs | | GPU idle per step | 1,162 µs | 1,115 µs | The draft-extend → draft gap of the median step (by that gap), same 400 µs scale, starting 40 µs before the draft-extend graph ends: **Before:** the unused token-level schedule runs on the PDL track; the draft graph starts at ~325 µs. **After:** only the pooled schedule is left; the draft graph starts at ~315 µs. --- ### CI States Latest PR Test (Base): :x: [Run #38672630259](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38672630259) Latest PR Test (Extra): :x: [Run #38672630306](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38672630306) Latest PR Test (AMD ROCm 10): :x: [Run #38672630094](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38672630094)
